verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶל־ בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- bā·nāw way·yō·mer hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū wə·’ag·gî·ḏāh lā·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiq·rā ’eṯ·ḵem bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Then Jacob . . . called for his sons and said Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS chamou Jacó a seus filhos, e disse: Ajuntai-vos, e anunciar-vos-ei o que vos há de acontecer nos dias vindouros;

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֲבִיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū wə·šim·‘ū bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·šim·‘ū ’el- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·ḇî·ḵem
verses.literal: Come together and listen O sons of Jacob listen to your father Israel
verses.literalPt: Ajuntai-vos, e ouvi, filhos de Jacó; e ouvi a Israel vosso pai.

verses.original: רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣רִי אַ֔תָּה כֹּחִ֖י וְרֵאשִׁ֣ית אוֹנִ֑י יֶ֥תֶר שְׂאֵ֖ת וְיֶ֥תֶר עָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵō·rî ’at·tāh kō·ḥî wə·rê·šîṯ ’ō·w·nî ye·ṯer śə·’êṯ wə·ye·ṯer ‘āz
verses.literal: Reuben you are my firstborn my might and the beginning of my strength excelling in honor excelling in power
verses.literalPt: Rúben, tu és meu primogênito, minha força e o princípio de meu vigor, o mais excelente em alteza e o mais excelente em poder.

verses.original: פַּ֤חַז כַּמַּ֙יִם֙ אַל־ תּוֹתַ֔ר כִּ֥י עָלִ֖יתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אָ֥ז חִלַּ֖לְתָּ יְצוּעִ֥י עָלָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaz kam·ma·yim ’al- tō·w·ṯar kî ‘ā·lî·ṯā miš·kə·ḇê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’āz ḥil·lal·tā yə·ṣū·‘î ‘ā·lāh
verses.literal: Uncontrolled as the waters you will no longer excel because you went up to your father’s bed onto my couch and defiled it
verses.literalPt: Impetuoso como a água, não serás o mais excelente, porquanto subiste ao leito de teu pai. Então o contaminaste; subiu à minha cama.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וֹן וְלֵוִ֖י אַחִ֑ים כְּלֵ֥י חָמָ֖ס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî ’a·ḥîm kə·lê ḥā·mās mə·ḵê·rō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Simeon and Levi are brothers their swords are weapons of violence
verses.literalPt: Simeão e Levi são irmãos; as suas espadas são instrumentos de violência.

verses.original: בְּסֹדָם֙ אַל־ תָּבֹ֣א נַפְשִׁ֔י בִּקְהָלָ֖ם אַל־ תֵּחַ֣ד כְּבֹדִ֑י כִּ֤י בְאַפָּם֙ הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָ֖ם עִקְּרוּ־ שֽׁוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·sō·ḏām ’al- tā·ḇō nap̄·šî biq·hā·lām ’al- tê·ḥaḏ kə·ḇō·ḏî kî ḇə·’ap·pām hā·rə·ḡū ’îš ū·ḇir·ṣō·nām ‘iq·qə·rū- šō·wr
verses.literal: May I never enter their council may I never join their assembly For they kill men in their anger and hamstring oxen on a whim
verses.literalPt: No seu secreto conselho não entre minha alma, com a sua congregação minha glória não se ajunte; porque no seu furor mataram homens, e na sua teima arrebataram bois.

verses.original: אָר֤וּר אַפָּם֙ כִּ֣י עָ֔ז וְעֶבְרָתָ֖ם כִּ֣י קָשָׁ֑תָה אֲחַלְּקֵ֣ם בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַאֲפִיצֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’ap·pām kî ‘āz wə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯām kî qā·šā·ṯāh ’ă·ḥal·lə·qêm bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wa·’ă·p̄î·ṣêm bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cursed be their anger for it is strong and their wrath for it is cruel I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel
verses.literalPt: Maldito seja o seu furor, pois era forte, e a sua ira, pois era dura; eu os dividirei em Jacó, e os espalharei em Israel.

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ יוֹד֣וּךָ אַחֶ֔יךָ יָדְךָ֖ בְּעֹ֣רֶף אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֥י אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh ’at·tāh yō·w·ḏū·ḵā ’a·ḥe·ḵā yā·ḏə·ḵā bə·‘ō·rep̄ ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lə·ḵā bə·nê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: Judah . . . your brothers shall praise you Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies your father’s sons shall bow down to you
verses.literalPt: Judá, a ti te louvarão os teus irmãos; a tua mão será sobre o pescoço de teus inimigos; os filhos de teu pai a ti se inclinarão.

verses.original: גּ֤וּר אַרְיֵה֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִטֶּ֖רֶף בְּנִ֣י עָלִ֑יתָ כָּרַ֨ע רָבַ֧ץ כְּאַרְיֵ֛ה וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֥י יְקִימֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gūr ’ar·yêh yə·hū·ḏāh miṭ·ṭe·rep̄ bə·nî ‘ā·lî·ṯā kā·ra‘ rā·ḇaṣ kə·’ar·yêh ū·ḵə·lā·ḇî mî yə·qî·men·nū
verses.literal: Judah is a young lion my son you return from the prey Like a lion he crouches and lies down like a lioness who dares to rouse him
verses.literalPt: Judá é um leãozinho, da presa subiste, filho meu; encurva-se, e deita-se como um leão, e como um leão velho; quem o despertará?

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָס֥וּר שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמְחֹקֵ֖ק מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑יו עַ֚ד כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֣א שִׁילֹה וְל֖וֹ יִקְּהַ֥ת עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·sūr šê·ḇeṭ mî·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·ḥō·qêq mib·bên raḡ·lāw ‘aḏ kî- yā·ḇō šī·lōh wə·lōw yiq·qə·haṯ ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: The scepter will not depart from Judah nor the staff from between his feet until . . . Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his
verses.literalPt: O cetro não se arredará de Judá, nem o legislador dentre seus pés, até que venha Siló; e a ele se congregarão os povos.

verses.original: אֹסְרִ֤י לַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ עִירֹה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָ֖ה בְּנִ֣י אֲתֹנ֑וֹ כִּבֵּ֤ס בַּיַּ֙יִן֙ לְבֻשׁ֔וֹ וּבְדַם־ עֲנָבִ֖ים סוּתֹה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·sə·rî lag·ge·p̄en ʿī·rōh wə·laś·śō·rê·qāh bə·nî ’ă·ṯō·nōw kib·bês bay·ya·yin lə·ḇu·šōw ū·ḇə·ḏam- ‘ă·nā·ḇîm sū·ṯōh
verses.literal: He ties his donkey to the vine his colt . . . to the choicest branch He washes his garments in wine his robes in the blood of grapes
verses.literalPt: Ele amarrará o seu jumentinho à vide, e o filho da sua jumenta à cepa mais excelente; ele lavará a sua roupa no vinho, e a sua capa em sangue de uvas.

verses.original: חַכְלִילִ֥י עֵינַ֖יִם מִיָּ֑יִן וּלְבֶן־ שִׁנַּ֖יִם מֵחָלָֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥaḵ·lî·lî ‘ê·na·yim mî·yā·yin ū·lə·ḇen- šin·na·yim mê·ḥā·lāḇ
verses.literal: His eyes are darker than wine and his teeth are whiter than milk
verses.literalPt: Os olhos serão vermelhos de vinho, e os dentes brancos de leite.

verses.original: זְבוּלֻ֕ן לְח֥וֹף יַמִּ֖ים יִשְׁכֹּ֑ן וְהוּא֙ לְח֣וֹף אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְיַרְכָת֖וֹ עַל־ צִידֹֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: zə·ḇū·lun lə·ḥō·wp̄ yam·mîm yiš·kōn wə·hū lə·ḥō·wp̄ ’o·nî·yō·wṯ wə·yar·ḵā·ṯōw ‘al- ṣî·ḏōn
verses.literal: Zebulun shall dwell . . . by the seashore . . . and become a harbor for ships his border shall extend to Sidon
verses.literalPt: Zebulom habitará no porto dos mares, e será como porto dos navios, e o seu termo será para Sidom.

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר חֲמֹ֣ר גָּ֑רֶם רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·š·ḵār ḥă·mōr gā·rem rō·ḇêṣ bên ham·miš·pə·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: Issachar is a strong donkey lying down between the sheepfolds
verses.literalPt: Issacar é jumento de fortes ossos, deitado entre dois fardos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא מְנֻחָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב וְאֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ כִּ֣י נָעֵ֑מָה וַיֵּ֤ט שִׁכְמוֹ֙ לִסְבֹּ֔ל וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־ עֹבֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yar mə·nu·ḥāh kî ṭō·wḇ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ kî nā·‘ê·māh way·yêṭ šiḵ·mōw lis·bōl way·hî lə·mas- ‘ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: He saw that his resting place was good and that his land was pleasant so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant
verses.literalPt: E viu ele que o descanso era bom, e que a terra era deliciosa e abaixou seu ombro para acarretar, e serviu debaixo de tributo.

verses.original: דָּ֖ן יָדִ֣ין עַמּ֑וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: dān yā·ḏîn ‘am·mōw kə·’a·ḥaḏ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Dã julgará o seu povo, como uma das tribos de Israel.

verses.original: יְהִי־ דָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ עֲלֵי־ דֶ֔רֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹ֖ן עֲלֵי־ אֹ֑רַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ֙ עִקְּבֵי־ ס֔וּס וַיִּפֹּ֥ל רֹכְב֖וֹ אָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî- ḏān nā·ḥāš ‘ă·lê- ḏe·reḵ šə·p̄î·p̄ōn ‘ă·lê- ’ō·raḥ han·nō·šêḵ ‘iq·qə·ḇê- sūs way·yip·pōl rō·ḵə·ḇōw ’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: He will be a snake by the road a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward
verses.literalPt: Dã será serpente junto ao caminho, uma víbora junto à vereda, que morde os calcanhares do cavalo, e faz cair o seu cavaleiro por detrás.

verses.original: לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lî·šū·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā qiw·wî·ṯî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I await Your salvation O LORD
verses.literalPt: A tua salvação espero, ó SENHOR!

verses.original: גָּ֖ד גְּד֣וּד יְגוּדֶ֑נּוּ וְה֖וּא יָגֻ֥ד עָקֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: gāḏ gə·ḏūḏ yə·ḡū·ḏen·nū wə·hū yā·ḡuḏ ‘ā·qêḇ
verses.literal: Gad will be attacked by raiders but he will attack their heels
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Gade, uma tropa o acometerá; mas ele a acometerá por fim.

verses.original: מֵאָשֵׁ֖ר שְׁמֵנָ֣ה לַחְמ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִתֵּ֖ן מַֽעֲדַנֵּי־ מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: mê·’ā·šêr šə·mê·nāh laḥ·mōw wə·hū yit·tên ma·‘ă·ḏan·nê- me·leḵ
verses.literal: Asher’s food will be rich he shall provide royal delicacies
verses.literalPt: De Aser, o seu pão será gordo, e ele dará delícias reais.

verses.original: נַפְתָּלִ֖י אַיָּלָ֣ה שְׁלֻחָ֑ה הַנֹּתֵ֖ן אִמְרֵי־ שָֽׁפֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: nap̄·tā·lî ’ay·yā·lāh šə·lu·ḥāh han·nō·ṯên ’im·rê- šā·p̄er
verses.literal: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns
verses.literalPt: Naftali é uma gazela solta; ele dá palavras formosas.

verses.original: בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָת֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֥ן פֹּרָ֖ת עֲלֵי־ עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי־ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: bên pō·rāṯ yō·w·sêp̄ bên pō·rāṯ ‘ă·lê- ‘ā·yin bā·nō·wṯ ṣā·‘ă·ḏāh ‘ă·lê- šūr
verses.literal: Joseph is a fruitful vine a fruitful vine by a spring whose branches scale . . . the wall
verses.literalPt: José é um ramo frutífero, ramo frutífero junto à fonte; seus ramos correm sobre o muro.

verses.original: וַֽיְמָרֲרֻ֖הוּ וָרֹ֑בּוּ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֻ֖הוּ בַּעֲלֵ֥י חִצִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·ră·ru·hū wā·rōb·bū way·yiś·ṭə·mu·hū ba·‘ă·lê ḥiṣ·ṣîm
verses.literal: The archers . . . attacked him with bitterness they aimed at him in hostility
verses.literalPt: Os flecheiros lhe deram amargura, e o flecharam e odiaram.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיָּפֹ֖זּוּ זְרֹעֵ֣י יָדָ֑יו מִידֵי֙ אֲבִ֣יר יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִשָּׁ֥ם רֹעֶ֖ה אֶ֥בֶן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·šeḇ bə·’ê·ṯān qaš·tōw way·yā·p̄ōz·zū zə·rō·‘ê yā·ḏāw mî·ḏê ’ă·ḇîr ya·‘ă·qōḇ miš·šām rō·‘eh ’e·ḇen yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet he steadied . . . his bow and his strong arms . . . were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob in the name of the Shepherd the Rock of Israel
verses.literalPt: O seu arco, porém, susteve-se no forte, e os braços de suas mãos foram fortalecidos pelas mãos do Valente de Jacó (de onde é o pastor e a pedra de Israel).

verses.original: מֵאֵ֨ל אָבִ֜יךָ וְיַעְזְרֶ֗ךָּ וְאֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִיבָ֣רְכֶ֔ךָּ בִּרְכֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מֵעָ֔ל בִּרְכֹ֥ת תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֣צֶת תָּ֑חַת בִּרְכֹ֥ת שָׁדַ֖יִם וָרָֽחַם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êl ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·ya‘·zə·re·kā wə·’êṯ šad·day wî·ḇā·rə·ḵe·kā bir·ḵōṯ šā·ma·yim mê·‘āl bir·ḵōṯ tə·hō·wm rō·ḇe·ṣeṯ tā·ḥaṯ bir·ḵōṯ šā·ḏa·yim wā·rā·ḥam
verses.literal: by the God of your father who helps you and by the Almighty who blesses you with blessings of the heavens above with blessings of the depths below with blessings of the breasts and womb
verses.literalPt: Pelo Deus de teu pai, o qual te ajudará, e pelo Todo-Poderoso, o qual te abençoará com bênçãos dos altos céus, com bênçãos do abismo que está embaixo, com bênçãos dos seios e da madre.

verses.original: בִּרְכֹ֣ת אָבִ֗יךָ גָּֽבְרוּ֙ עַל־ בִּרְכֹ֣ת הוֹרַ֔י עַֽד־ תַּאֲוַ֖ת גִּבְעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֙ין֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: bir·ḵōṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā gā·ḇə·rū ‘al- bir·ḵōṯ hō·w·ray ‘aḏ- ta·’ă·waṯ giḇ·‘ōṯ ‘ō·w·lām tih·yɛn lə·rōš yō·w·sêp̄ ū·lə·qā·ḏə·qōḏ nə·zîr ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: The blessings of your father have surpassed . . . the blessings of the ancient mountains . . . and the bounty of the everlasting hills May they rest on the head of Joseph on the brow of the prince of his brothers
verses.literalPt: As bênçãos de teu pai excederão as bênçãos de meus pais, até à extremidade dos outeiros eternos; elas estarão sobre a cabeça de José, e sobre o alto da cabeça do que foi separado de seus irmãos.

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִין֙ זְאֵ֣ב יִטְרָ֔ף בַּבֹּ֖קֶר יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְלָעֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bin·yā·mîn zə·’êḇ yiṭ·rāp̄ bab·bō·qer yō·ḵal ‘aḏ wə·lā·‘e·reḇ yə·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl
verses.literal: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf . . . in the morning he devours the prey in the evening he divides the plunder
verses.literalPt: Benjamim é lobo que despedaça; pela manhã comerá a presa, e à tarde repartirá o despojo.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֛לֶּה שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר וְ֠זֹאת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֨ר לָהֶ֤ם אֲבִיהֶם֙ וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אוֹתָ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּבִרְכָת֖וֹ בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl šə·nêm ‘ā·śār wə·zōṯ ’ă·šer- dib·ber lā·hem ’ă·ḇî·hem way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·w·ṯām ’îš ’ă·šer kə·ḇir·ḵā·ṯōw bê·raḵ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: These are the tribes of Israel twelve . . . in all and this was what their father said to them He blessed them - and he blessed each one with a suitable blessing
verses.literalPt: Todas estas são as doze tribos de Israel; e isto é o que lhes falou seu pai quando os abençoou; a cada um deles abençoou segundo a sua bênção.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו אוֹתָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אֲנִי֙ נֶאֱסָ֣ף אֶל־ עַמִּ֔י קִבְר֥וּ אֹתִ֖י אֶל־ אֲבֹתָ֑י אֶל־ הַ֨מְּעָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׂדֵ֖ה עֶפְר֥וֹן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’ō·w·ṯām way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’ă·nî ne·’ĕ·sāp̄ ’el- ‘am·mî qiḇ·rū ’ō·ṯî ’el- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāy ’el- ham·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer biś·ḏêh ‘ep̄·rō·wn ha·ḥit·tî
verses.literal: Then Jacob instructed them - I am about to be gathered to my people Bury me with my fathers . . . in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite
verses.literalPt: Depois ordenou-lhes, e disse-lhes: Eu me congrego ao meu povo; sepultai-me com meus pais, na cova que está no campo de Efrom, o heteu,

verses.original: בַּמְּעָרָ֞ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַמְרֵ֖א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ קָנָ֨ה אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י לַאֲחֻזַּת־ קָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: bam·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer biś·ḏêh ham·maḵ·pê·lāh ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê- mam·rê bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ’ă·šer qā·nāh ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh mê·’êṯ ‘ep̄·rōn ha·ḥit·tî la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ- qā·ḇer
verses.literal: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near . . . Mamre in the land of Canaan This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site
verses.literalPt: Na cova que está no campo de Macpela, que está em frente de Manre, na terra de Canaã, a qual Abraão comprou com aquele campo de Efrom, o heteu, por herança de sepultura.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה קָֽבְר֞וּ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֗ם וְאֵת֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ שָׁ֚מָּה קָבְר֣וּ אֶת־ יִצְחָ֔ק וְאֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְשָׁ֥מָּה קָבַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־ לֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh qā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·’êṯ śā·rāh ’iš·tōw šām·māh qā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq wə·’êṯ riḇ·qāh ’iš·tōw wə·šām·māh qā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- lê·’āh
verses.literal: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried and there I buried Leah
verses.literalPt: Ali sepultaram a Abraão e a Sara sua mulher; ali sepultaram a Isaque e a Rebeca sua mulher; e ali eu sepultei a Lia.

verses.original: מִקְנֵ֧ה הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵי־ חֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: miq·nêh haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ham·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer- bōw mê·’êṯ bə·nê- ḥêṯ
verses.literal: The field and the cave that is in it . . . were purchased from the Hittites . . .
verses.literalPt: O campo e a cova que está nele, foram comprados aos filhos de Hete.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֤ל יַעֲקֹב֙ לְצַוֺּ֣ת אֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף רַגְלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַמִּטָּ֑ה וַיִּגְוַ֖ע וַיֵּאָ֥סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ṣaw·wōṯ ’eṯ- bā·nāw way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ raḡ·lāw ’el- ham·miṭ·ṭāh way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last and he was gathered to his people
verses.literalPt: Acabando, pois, Jacó de dar instruções a seus filhos, encolheu os pés na cama, e expirou, e foi congregado ao seu povo.
